resource: Committed damage receipts retained at once per live creature actor generation
unit: retained damage receipts per creature generation
allocation_impact: Retention, not admission: when 16 receipts are retained, a new distinct occurrence evicts the oldest evictable receipt (sequenced, and either from a superseded session or covered by its attacker's current high-water mark) and still applies; the evicted occurrence's resubmission is refused StaleAttackerSequence, never re-applied. Only when no retained receipt is evictable (unsequenced, or its attacker is untracked past COMBAT01-DAMAGE-CONTRIBUTORS-PER-CREATURE) is the new occurrence refused DamageReceiptCapacityExceeded, fail-closed with HP and every receipt untouched (GAME-ABILITY-01 section 12). Each receipt retains at most MAX_OWNER_COMMIT_BINDING_BYTES = 4096 bytes of binding.
boundary_tests: max=16: sixteen distinct occurrences from one attacker all retain and apply
max+1=17: a 17th evictable occurrence evicts the oldest receipt and still applies; the evicted occurrence's replay is StaleAttackerSequence and mutates nothing
max=16 non-evictable: sixteen unsequenced receipts retain, with never an eviction of an unsequenced receipt
max+1=17 non-evictable: a 17th occurrence with no evictable receipt is DamageReceiptCapacityExceeded and mutates nothing
a 20 HP creature is killed by more than 16 distinct occurrences with none refused by capacity and exactly one lethal receipt
notes: D140-D144, D4 multi-hit damage receipt decision. Ephemeral, per-creature-generation state only, dropped with the slot (D52). The replay identity of an attributed commit is carrier-derived from (CharacterId, GameSessionId, CommandId sequence, sub_ordinal); sub_ordinal is bounded by the already-registered ABILITY01-EFFECT-PLAN-ENTRIES = 2 (mirrored, not re-registered). Registered by OTV2-20260929-d4-1-multi-hit.
